answer_1.quote: LLMs generate counterfactuals using established counterfactual generation approaches (Figure  in Appendix A).

answer_2.quote: LFR is a common metric of choice . It is the percentage of valid counterfactuals where the ground truth labels are flipped out of the total number of instances.

answer_3.quote: LLMs are commonly employed to validate the generated counterfactuals.

answer_4.quote: We recruit 90 native English speakers and, for each of the three datasets, randomly sample 45 indices. For each subset, i.e., a generator-dataset pair (Table  in Appendix G), the counterfactuals generated by the corresponding generator model LLM G for the selected indices are evaluated by two human annotators.
